database.name: crunchyroll_popular
database.description: Complete database of every show listed on Crunchyroll's 'Most Popular' page (https://www.crunchyroll.com/videos/popular), in popularity order. The page's feed contained 1104 tiles; 7 shows appeared on 2 tiles each (a property of Crunchyroll's popularity feed, verified byte-identical and identical positions across two independent capture sessions), so the database contains 1097 unique shows with every raw tile position preserved.

pagination.exhaustion_proof: last data page returned 24/36 items and the overflow page at start=1104 returned 0 items

database.rank_definition: rank = dense popularity rank over unique shows (1 = most popular; array order == rank order). tile_positions = the exact 1-based position(s) of the show's tile(s) in the raw feed as rendered on the page.
database.url_format: https://www.crunchyroll.com/series/{id}/{slug_title} — the id is REQUIRED: slug-only URLs (/series/{slug}) answer HTTP 200 but render 'Page not found' in the app (verified by headless-Chrome title probing).
database.losslessness: Every field of every show is preserved exactly as returned by the API; the only additions are 'rank', 'tile_positions' and 'url'. Raw page payloads are archived archived (see the provenance bundles under provenance/) for byte-level provenance.

field_reference.rank: int — dense popularity rank over unique shows (1 = most popular)
field_reference.tile_positions: int[] — 1-based position(s) of this show's tile(s) in the raw page feed (length > 1 means Crunchyroll's feed listed this show more than once)
field_reference.url: string — canonical Crunchyroll page URL, format https://www.crunchyroll.com/series/{id}/{slug_title}
field_reference.title: string — display title
field_reference.description: string — show description (empty string when the API provides none)
field_reference.slug / slug_title: string — URL slugs (slug_title is used in canonical URLs)
field_reference.last_public: string (ISO-8601 UTC) — timestamp of the most recently published episode/movie
field_reference.images: object — poster_wide (16:9), poster_tall (2:3), promo_image; each is an array of size-variants with width/height/type/source
field_reference.images_localized: object — localized key-art asset templates (URLs contain a '{:param}' CDN transform placeholder); present where the API provides it
field_reference.series_metadata: object — availability_status, extended_description, episode_count, season_count, extended_maturity_rating{system,rating,level,advisories}, maturity_ratings[], content_descriptors[], content_descriptors_with_symbol[], is_mature, mature_blocked, is_subbed, is_dubbed, is_simulcast, linked_guid, availability_notes, audio_locales[], subtitle_locales[], series_launch_year, awards[{text,icon_url,is_current_award,is_winner}], tenant_categories[] (genres), language_presentation{...}
field_reference.language_presentation: object — locale presentation defaults for the listing (audio_notation, text_notation, audio_locale, text_locale, ...)
field_reference.rating: object — Crunchyroll star ratings: '1s'..'5s' = per-star vote counts {displayed (approximate), unit, percentage}, 'average' = average rating 0-5, 'total' = total number of ratings

semantics_caveats.episode_count: Number of playable episodes as the popular page displays it. This equals the `media_count` field of Crunchyroll's CMS series endpoint. (The CMS endpoint's own episode_count/season_count use a different counting model — e.g. dub-only seasons counted separately — and can differ; verified on 45/45 sampled shows that this database's episode_count == CMS media_count, while titles matched 100%.)
semantics_caveats.audio_locales / subtitle_locales: Semantically UNORDERED sets: the API returns these arrays in a different order on every call. Order here is exactly as served at extraction time; compare as sets.
semantics_caveats.popularity_order: Popularity ranks are a live, continuously-updating ordering. This database is a verified snapshot at 'extracted_at_utc'; live drift is measured and reported in data/verification_report.json.

duplicated_shows.title: The Klutzy Class Monitor and the Girl with the Short Skirt

duplicate_audit.explanation: These 7 shows each appeared on 2 tiles in the raw popularity feed. Entries were byte-identical, and the exact same ids at the exact same tile positions appeared in the independent headless-Chrome capture — i.e. this is how Crunchyroll's feed is served, not a crawl artifact. The database keeps one record per show; all raw positions are in 'tile_positions'.

notes: The feed was captured twice independently: (1) a real headless-Chrome session that scrolled the live page until the infinite-scroll feed was exhausted, and (2) a direct sequential crawl of the same API the page uses. They matched tile-for-tile.
2 shows have an empty description (OFFSIDE, BangG Dream! Movies) — exactly as the API serves it; preserved as-is.
9 titles are shared by multiple distinct shows (different ids, e.g. remasters/alternate entries) — kept as separate records since they are distinct catalog entries.

shows.title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
shows.description: After the party of heroes defeated the Demon King, they restored peace to the land and returned to lives of solitude. Generations pass, and the elven mage Frieren comes face to face with humanity’s mortality. She takes on a new apprentice and promises to fulfill old friends’ dying wishes. Can an elven mind make peace with the nature of life and death? Frieren embarks on her quest to find out.

Meet Yugi and his best buds Joey, Tristan and Téa.  They share a love for the newest game that’s sweeping the nation: Duel Monsters!

Legend has it 5000 years ago, ancient Egyptian Pharaohs used to play a magical game very similar to Duel Monsters.  This ancient game involved magical ceremonies, which were used to foresee the future and ultimately decide one’s destiny.  They called it the Shadow Games.  Since the game used so many magical spells and ferocious creatures, it wasn’t long before the game got out of hand and threatened to destroy the world.

When he arrives at the capital, the people discover that this oblivious kid from hard knocks might be more powerful than anyone expected.

shows.title: Cautious Hero: The Hero is Overpowered but Overly Cautious
shows.description: Goddess Ristarte summons Seiya Ryuuguuin, an OVERLY cautious hero to save the world of Gaeabrande. Seiya is obsessed with muscle training and buying extra armor to deal with low level creatures. It’s simply one cautious mission at-a-time for this hero!

shows.title: Betrothed to My Sister's Ex
shows.description: Marie, the second daughter of a poor baron’s household, is treated like a servant by her parents. Even at Marie’s birthday party, her beautiful elder sister, Anastasia, is the star. Outside, Marie bumps into Count Kyuros Granado, who falls for her at first sight. Yet, due to a misunderstanding, the Count proposes to Anastasia. After a tragic accident, Marie must marry the count instead!

But this unemployed magic-less demon has found a new calling as an adventurer! His second life might just be not so bad after all, as long the villagers don’t find out he’s not human.

Takuto goes unconscious during a hospitalization and awakens on the continent of Idoragya, which looks just like the game. Takuto meets Sludge Atou, his favorite unit in the game, and decides to build Mynoghra, an evil empire, in this isekai apocalypse anime.

shows.title: Handyman Saitou in Another World
shows.description: Handyman Saitou has never felt special in his life. When he’s dropped into a medieval fantasy world, he gathers a party of unique beings to survive. Surrounded by a heavy warrior, a spell-forgetting wizard, and even a divine fairy princess, he yearns to be helpful. But after Saitou saves everyone during a raid, it’s clear that having a handyman on an adventure isn’t just useful, it’s essential!

shows.title: The Shiunji Family Children
shows.description: The Shiunji family with their seven children reside in a mansion within Tokyo’s Setagaya ward. The eldest son, Arata, is tired of being pushed around by his five sisters and daydreams of a life without them. That is, until Arata’s father reveals a shocking truth—Arata isn’t biologically related to his sisters! The siblings’ relationships will be tested as they navigate life in this new light.

Now, everyone suspects that she’s the infamous Demon Lord. What future awaits her?

Shido is recruited to help "seal" the sprits and end their threat to mankind. There’s just one catch: the only way to seal a spirit—is to make her fall in love with you.

Now, he and his teammates will face stiff competition on the road to the National Tournament.

shows.title: Grand Blue Dreaming
shows.description: Dive into Iori Kitahara’s chaotic college life in Izu, where his uncle’s diving shop, Grand Blue, becomes the epicenter of madness. Instead of serene ocean views and good times with his roommate-cousins, he’s roped into the wild antics of a diving club and the family treats him like he’s nothing. Between uni life and ever-escalating buffoonery, Iori’s youth is off to a hilariously unhinged start!

Together they’ll unravel the mysteries of the supernatural world and forge an unexpected bond.

shows.title: The Weakest Tamer Began a Journey to Pick Up Trash

Together, the delicate duo embarks on a heartwarming journey of survival and discovers there’s more to Ivy than being starless.

Cosmic Era year X492…

Armed with a quirky social media poll, she sets off on a spontaneous journey of random crowdsourced destinations. From hilarious mishaps to heartwarming encounters, Chika discovers inspiration, friendship, and herself, one unpredictable stop at a time.

shows.title: Myself; Yourself
shows.description: Sana Hikada returns to his hometown after 5 years away living in Tokyo. Although there are some changes to the town, most has remained the same. shows.description: The story takes place in a fictional world called Arcadia, where life-draining monsters called Thanatos plague the populace. The only ones who have the power to exterminate these creatures are Purifiers, but only a few exist. shows.title: Meiji Gekken: 1874
shows.description: By 1874, seven years have passed since the end of the samurai era. A former samurai, Shizuma Orikasa works as a rickshaw driver in Tokyo while looking for his fiancée, Sumie Kanomata, who went missing during the Boshin War. Shizuma thwarts an assassination attempt and joins the newly established police department, where he’ll fight to stop dark forces from overthrowing the government.

shows.title: Fractale
shows.description: Clain lives quietly amongst doppels—holograms that replace his parents and friends. Alone on a typical day, he saves a shrine maiden from pursuers and treats her wounds. He’s mystified by her worldly charms, but she disappears—leaving only a pendant behind. When a curious girl emerges from the amulet, Clain’s life takes a chaotic turn as he seeks to unlock the secrets his new friend holds.

shows.title: Stardust Telepath
shows.description: Umika is a sweet yet shy high school girl. She has trouble speaking to others and dreams of having a friend from another planet. But her lonely school life takes a cosmic turn when she meets transfer student Yu, an alien with telepathic powers! The two become close and promise to go to space one day. So, they decide to build a rocket and shoot for the stars, making new friends along the way.

shows.title: Hakuoki ~Demon of the Fleeting Blossom~ (Drama)
shows.description: The time is one of upheaval, at the end of Bakumatsu period. A young woman named Yukimura Chizuru travels from Edo to the capital, Kyoto, in search of her missing father. Suddenly, the Rasetsu (inhuman beings committing terrible deeds) appear before her, trailed by the Shinsengumi, a unit of warriors lead by Hijikata Toshizou. The Shinsengumi deal with the Rasetsu before them in an instant. Chizuru, however, doesn't know that the fate of her father, Koudou, is inextricably bound to both the Rasetsu and the Shinsengumi. Before long, Chizuru puts herself in the Shinsengumi's care as she continues the search for her father.

shows.title: Sorcery in the Big City
shows.description:
It's the Christmas season, and Akari Kido is back in New York with her favorite teddy bear, Apple, for the first time in 15 years. Akari returns to take part in an officer exchange program with the NYPD, where her father once served, but it doesn't take long for her to run into a tricky sorceress named Liberty.

When Liberty's magic creates havoc on the street, a teddy bear with a familiar-sounding voice comes to Akari's rescue. It's Apple! But Apple's mysterious reappearance only raises further questions. Who is Apple, really? What is Liberty doing here? And can Akari truly save Christmas?

shows.title: Trapezium
shows.description:
In order to achieve her dream of becoming an idol by any means necessary, Yu Azuma, a first-year student at Joshu East High School decides to seek out three beautiful young girls from each of the four corners of her prefecture (north, south, east, and west) to form an idol group. 

As she searches Joshu from north to south and east to west, she finds her three soon-to-be fellow group members. From Holy Teneritas Southern Girls' Academy comes second-year Ranko Kashima, a high-class girl with a distinctive curly hairstyle who admires Ochofujin ("Madame Butterfly."). From West Tech Vocational High School comes Kurumi Taiga, a girl who wears cute, oversized jackets with long sleeves and aims to win the championship at a robotics competition. The final member, Mika Kamei, hails from Joshu North High School, a kind-hearted girl who dedicates her time to volunteering. With the help of Shinji Kudo, Yu's "collaborator" and confidante, Yu brings together these three young girls and sets the stage for their road to idol fame and stardom.

shows.title: Stereopony
shows.description:
ステレオポニー

Green and vulnerable yet beautiful...

That is how this all-girl rock band from Okinawa, Stereopony would be described.

Their ages averaging 18, a time full of conflicts and pressure concerning love and friendship. That really intense period in life helped mold their pure and straight-foward sound.

An advanced type of nostalgic rock may sound a little strange. However, it truly hits the spot and for kids their age, it portrays their reality. That is Stereopony's world.

Their susceptibility is defined by edgy, wistful but also refreshing at the same time.

Causing a storm within the riotous teenagers with their red-hot rock sound, they will become an agitator leading the way for rock kids!

[b]Members[/b]
NOHANA - Bass Guitar
AIMI - Lead Guitar/Lead Vocals
SHIHO - Drums

shows.title: Kylee
shows.description:
Singer, currently lives in Arizona. Born between an American father and Japanese mother, Kylee has been in touch with both Western and J-Pop music without boundaries.

The young teenage artist has first chosen Japan to start off her career as a professional singer.

Kylee sang the National Anthem at an NBA game when she was only 11 years old, and in August 2009 at 15, she became the youngest artist to perform at SUMMER SONIC.

She's the new generation pop icon, full of extraordinary and unprecedented experiences, but she's also a 17-year-old high school student.

She's bright and intelligent, an honor student with outstanding grades.

shows.description:
As the former lead vocal in the popular J-pop group KAT-TUN, JIN AKANISHI helped establish numerous records. Their 11 CD singles, 4 CD albums, and 7 DVDs all reached #1 in the Japanese trade magazine Oricon (the Japanese equivalent of Billboard magazine), and in 2009, KAT-TUN became the first musician to perform eight consecutive days at Tokyo Dome, the largest and most prestigious arena in Japan.

After just five months of learning sorcery, Kunon surpasses his mentor and continues to hone his talents as he attempts a feat that's never been done before. A fantasy about a young man, and blind genius, who opens up the world through his curiosity and pursuit of magic is about to begin.

shows.title: Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha EXCEEDS: Gun Blaze Vengeance
shows.description: Thirty years ago, aliens attacked Earth and nearly brought humanity to extinction. Since then, mankind has clawed for survival, fighting the invaders for land, and the UN established EXCEEDS, an agency to stave off alien threats. shows.title: PSYREN
shows.description: One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious red phone card. Days later, his childhood friend, Sakurako Amamiya, who possessed the same card, suddenly vanishes. In search of her, he’s drawn into rumors of a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances by a secret organization known as Psyren. When he accesses the group, a deadly game that changes his fate forever begins.

shows.title: Agents of the Four Seasons Dance of Spring
shows.description: When the Agent of Spring, Hinagiku Kayo, is abducted, spring itself vanishes—plunging the world into unending winter. Refusing to give up, her devoted guard, Sakura Himedaka, searches for her for years. When Hinagiku suddenly returns, the two set out to restore the lost season, face the past that tore them apart, and reclaim the warmth they refuse to lose again.

shows.description: An orphan since hatched, a lone dragon named “Uncle Wings” is taken in by a family of magic-wielding cats and raised as one of their own. shows.title: Baby Metal
shows.description:
In 2010, BABYMETAL was formed as “the mix of Japanese schoolgirl J-POP and Heavy Metal”, not what you typically think of as heavy metal but a new genre. In October 2010, they performed “Doki Doki Morning” as their first live performance, and the song “Sakura Gakuin 2010 ~message~” was included in the album. Their new song “Ijime, Dame, Zettai” was performed at the event of Sakura Gakuin in July, and TOKYO IDOL FESTIVAL in August. It became a buzz because of the melodic speed metal sound, its sensational lyric of theme about “Ijime” and their performance incorporating the Wall of Death. BABYMETAL’s heavy metal and performance drove the audience to create a mosh pit at the live house. Chaos ensued in spite of the fact that the show was an IDOL EVENT (Tower Records Shinjuku 13th Birthday Event ~NO MUSIC, NO IDOL?~ at Shinjuku LOFT in October 2011). BABYMETAL pursues the only one unit in the world under the flag of “the mix of Japanese schoolgirl J-POP and Heavy Metal”.

http://www.babymetal.jp/

shows.title: Kalafina
shows.description: Kalafina is a Japanese female vocal trio produced by the hit-making sound producer, Yuki Kajiura.  Keiko, Wakana, and Hikaru, the current members of Kalafina, have voices that perfectly match the music composed by Kajiura. shows.title: The Irregular at Magic High School: Reminiscence Arc
shows.description: April 2095. A century has passed since magic was established as actual technology. The two siblings enroll at a prestigious school for magicians called the National Magic University Affiliated First High School, better known as "Magic High School." Tatsuya, the older brother, is an "irregular" with a fatal flaw to his magic powers. The younger sister, Miyuki, is a star student with unmatched magical talent. Though they are now close enough to be mistaken as a couple, just a few years ago, the two had a dysfunctional relationship, where they were nothing more than a master and servant. One incident, however, alters their relationship forever. Three years ago in Okinawa, an unforgettable experience turns their souls and destinies on their heads. From the hit series with over 20 million copies sold worldwide comes the new Reminiscence Arc, the prologue to the duo's magic school life.

Hangry&Angry is a musical project spinoff from the popular Japanese designer h.NAOTO. The two member unit is made up of former Morning Musume members. Vocalists Hitomi Yoshizawa and Rika Ishikawa play the characters Hangry and Angry respectively.

shows.title: Def Tech
shows.description:
A creator unit consisting of Shen and Micro, they sing, write, produce and arrange their songs, and established the new genre-straddling "Jawaiian Reggae."

Shen was born in China and grew up in Hawaii. Micro was born and bred in Tokyo. Shen had visited Japan many times while growing up and they met in Tokyo and started their music collaborations in 2000.

Their three albums; 1st album "Def Tech" (2005), 2nd album "Lokahi Lani" (2005), and 3rd album "Catch The Wave" (2006), recorded a phenomenal sales and made a solid position in the Japanese music scene. Their total record sales marked over 5 million copies. 

In 2006, Def Tech went on a concert tour including Nippon Budokan ―― a massive success and released two DVDs, "Budokan" and "OKINAWA LIVE" which include their performances from the tour. In September 2007, they disbanded due to the difference of their musical directions. After their solo activities and collaborations with other artists, Shen and Micro reunited and started recording together in 2010. 

In June 2010, they suddenly uploaded the music video of "A-1" on their official website which received over 200,000 views on the first day. 

In August 2010, they gave a guerrilla performance at Summer Sonic without any advance notice and had audiences of over 5,000. In October 2010, Def Tech released their 4th album "Mind Shift," which topped in the album sales chart at iTunes music store in Japan. In February 2011, they went on a tour and gave the fans a steady impression of the reunion.

This year, they appeared at another performance at Summer Sonic 2011 and had audiences of over 7,000. In September, they performed for their first time at high school festivals in affected area of Tohoku.

Def Tech started the production of the 5th album from the beginning of 2011 in Japan and Hawaii. And now the new album "UP," including 13 songs, will be released on October 5, 2011. They will perform a live concert at Budokan on November 11, 2011, named "DefTech 11.11.11 BUDOKAN Special!!".
